integrity: Self-contained analytic proof with standalone finite numerical and exact-rational diagnostics; finite computations are non-certifying for the global theorem.
scientific_limitations: For each fixed degree at least three, the theorem holds at sufficiently small positive outermost-zero radii only; no explicit radius threshold or uniform degree bound. Previously published mathematically equivalent Poisson energy formulations cannot be ruled out conclusively; independent audit not performed.
title: Sharp inward relaxation of small-radius Blaschke zero polygons in every degree
